passage: Neither the engineers who designed the bridge nor the inspector who approved its plans ______ the effect that strong crosswinds would have on the deck.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
steps: With “neither…nor,” the verb agrees with the nearer subject: “the inspector” (singular).
“Were,” “have been” and “are” are plural or wrongly timed.
key: With neither/nor and either/or, match the verb to the closer subject.
